steps.en: Build local packages and provision a project through the host runtime
steps.zh: 构建本地包，由宿主运行时预配项目

steps.en: Import the complete source directory into the shared Store
steps.zh: 把完整源目录导入共享 Store

steps.en: Open the project and fork a Branch for the attempt
steps.zh: 打开项目，为本次尝试分支

steps.en: Create a Sandbox and mount the Branch as a writable Workspace
steps.zh: 创建 Sandbox，挂载可写分支视图

steps.en: Expose the shared base with a private writable overlay
steps.zh: 提供共享底层与私有写覆盖层

steps.en: Run the test command, explicitly commit changes, then unmount
steps.zh: 执行测试，显式提交改动后卸载

steps.en: Retain a reusable full-tree checkpoint on the Branch
steps.zh: 在分支保留可复用的完整目录检查点

value.en: Trial workspaces share prepared files instead of copying the base for every attempt
value.zh: 多次尝试共享已准备的文件，不必逐次复制底层
